$comment: Tracked authority-pin manifest for the binding-specification family. One entry per incorporated upstream authority per pinned edition; digests are sha256 over the exact bytes at the pinned source (git-tree entries pin a commit and digest a probe file inside the pinned tree). Verified by scripts/verify-authority-pins.mjs; bytes are not stored in this repository. `families` records applicability where one authority serves multiple binding-specification families. An entry carrying `status: reference-only` prepares verified bytes that no binding-specification text yet cites; it states why, carries an empty citedBy, and the verifier asserts that its matchTokens appear in no specification text until the status is deliberately removed.
